From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Urgent: NeuroScale request — temporary H100 allocation + reservation hold & overage concession

Team,

NeuroScale (contact: Jay Lee) just sent an ask that requires deal-desk / exec approval. Quick summary:

- Ask: Temporarily allocate 4x H100 GPUs (they are currently on A100 reserved capacity) for a 6-week burst window starting as soon as we can schedule it. They also want a 30-day reservation hold so those A100 slots aren’t released while they test H100 performance, and a reduced overage rate for the burst period.
- Why: Their new real-time model (low-latency variant) shows a 2.4x token throughput improvement on H100 and materially reduces unit cost on inference. They need to run a production pilot in November to validate latency SLOs before committing to a Dedicated sku migration.
- Financial ask: Concession to move overage rate from standard $1.50/GPU-hour to $0.95/GPU-hour for the 6-week window, plus a one-time 7% platform fee credit to offset migration setup.
- Risk ask: Reservation hold on their existing A100 commit for 30 days to avoid reallocation while they test.

Attachments: NeuroScale_MA-2026-10-18-redlines.pdf (redlines from legal), capacity_runbook_QS_v3.xlsx (ops runbook).

My read: this is borderline — we can see meaningful long-term revenue upside if the pilot converts. The capacity team warns H100 inventory is tight in our us-west region in early Nov. Ops says we can support a short H100 swap if we put a reservation hold and route the allocation through Dedicated temporary pool, but it will require a firm start/end date and an exec sign-off on modified overage pricing.

Requesting: Lauren / Vivek / Marissa — executive approval (or denial) on the three items below so I can respond to Jay by EOD tomorrow:
1) Approve temporary allocation of 4x H100 for 6 weeks starting no earlier than 2026-11-02
2) Approve 30-day reservation hold on their A100 commit (no replacement by platform during hold)
3) Approve temporary overage rate of $0.95/GPU-hour and 7% one-time platform credit for the pilot period

If approved, I will ask Ops to schedule and Legal to finalize the short addendum.

Thanks,
Rachel

Thanks for the clear summary, Rachel. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:

- Start window: can Ops guarantee a firm start date and confirm the exact H100 SKU (e.g., H100-80GB)? We need to know if this will force other commitments to shift.
- Conversion language: is the pilot tied to a gating metric (latency 95p < 120ms) that would trigger a full migration? We should avoid indefinite holds.

My provisional position: I am comfortable approving a shorter pilot (4 weeks) with a 14-day reservation hold instead of 30 days, and approve a temporary overage concession but not lower than $1.10/GPU-hour unless Sales secures a written commitment clause (30-day notice of intent to migrate, or minimum conversion target).

If Vivek / Marissa disagree, please push now — we need a firm reply to Jay.

-LB

Appreciate the fast thread. I’ll be brief:

- Approve conditional H100 allocation of 4x H100-80GB for a 6-week pilot, but require Ops to confirm resource scheduling (no later than 10/25) and include an automatic fallback to their A100 commit if H100 is reclaimed.
- Approve 30-day hold only if Sales secures a pilot conversion clause: NeuroScale must provide a non-binding notice of intent to migrate within 30 days after pilot end OR commit to a minimum 3-month Dedicated contract if latency/throughput targets are met. If they refuse, then reduce hold to 14 days.
- Overage rate: approve $1.00/GPU-hour for the pilot (compromise between Rachel’s request and Lauren’s floor), plus the 7% platform-service credit.

Marissa: please prep a one-paragraph addendum for Legal (terms above) and add a strict start/end date window so Ops can proceed. Rachel: tell Jay we can likely do this and that final sign-off will be formalized in the addendum.

—Vivek

All — documenting final decision for Rachel to respond to the customer and for Legal/Ops:

Approved items (exec sign-off):
1) Temporary allocation: 4 x H100-80GB for a 6-week pilot (target window 2026-11-02 to 2026-12-14).
2) Reservation hold: 30-day hold on existing A100 commit, conditional on clause below.
3) Overage: $1.00/GPU-hour for pilot period.
4) One-time platform credit: 7% applied to pilot invoices.

Conditions to include in the addendum (must be signed / acknowledged before provision):
- NeuroScale will provide a written Notice of Intent to Migrate within 30 days after pilot completion if latency targets (95p < 120ms) are met, OR commit to a minimum 3-month Dedicated contract within 14 days.
- Firm pilot start date will be confirmed by Ops by 2026-10-25. If Ops cannot confirm, the hold reduces to 14 days and pilot start is rescheduled.
- Platform credit will be invoiced as a credit line item and applied against pilot charges only.

Rachel: please send Jay the addendum stub (I attached redlines) and request formal acknowledgement. Ops, once Rachel confirms acknowledgement, please schedule the H100 allocation and confirm fallbacks.
